title: "Magic" Coca-Cola Cake (500K Celebration)
ingredients: 1 box chocolate cake mix, any brand
instructions: Step 2: Pour the dry cake mix into a bowl and add the entire 12-ounce can of Coca-Cola. Mix until well combined.
Step 3: Pour into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish and bake at 350°F for about 29-31 minutes, or until the cake is done in the center.
Step 4: While the cake is baking, add the butter, Coca-Cola, and cocoa powder to a saucepan. Heat and stir until the butter is completely melted and everything is combined.
Step 5: Bring the mixture to a boil. As soon as it reaches a boil, remove it from the heat.
Step 6: Stir in the vanilla, then add the powdered sugar and mix until smooth and creamy.
Step 7: As soon as the cake comes out of the oven, pour the warm chocolate Coca-Cola icing right over the hot cake.
Step 8: Let it cool, slice it up, and enjoy.
notes: Posted by Cherie Hicks Leone to celebrate hitting 500,000 followers; she credits a friend named Hunter for the idea. No eggs, milk, or oil in the cake batter — just cake mix and Coca-Cola. Icing is poured over the cake while both are hot.
